Exit: An ancient standing stone etched with glowing runes. Use it to open a gateway to other worlds.
A kit containing everything needed to raise a Portal Hub. Place it anywhere — then use the portal to travel to other worlds.
You begin with a Portal Kit. Place it anywhere to open a gateway to other worlds.
Bind a witch stone into fresh fur and dried wolfsbane, sealed with animal fat. Assembles a portable Portal Hub kit.
A small metal nail, perfect for joining wood. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron.
Hammer a copper, tin or bronze nugget into a nail of the same metal.

Crafted: From a copper, tin or bronze nugget using a hammer, or six at a time by casting a heated copper, tin or bronze bar (one mud brick and one clay as the mould); iron nails are forged from 4 iron nuggets with a hammer (Forge Iron Nails, 4 nails). The nail is the metal of its nugget or bar. Uses: Construction and crafting. A nail of any metal works the same in every recipe, iron included. Smelts: Returns 1 nugget of its own metal in a furnace at 1100°C or hotter.
A flat metal sheet, hammered thin. It is the metal it was made from: copper, ghost bronze, tin, tin bronze, white bronze or iron.
Hammer a heated lump of metal flat into a copper sheet.
A tin solder stick. Useful for joining metal parts or sealing seams.
Forge 4 iron nuggets into 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200).
Melt a tin-grade metal nugget into solder sticks.
Hammer 6 iron nuggets flat into an Iron Sheet (a Metal Sheet of Metal Type 200), ready for iron-grade tools and armor.
Hammer a heated Ghost Bronze, Tin, Tin Bronze or White Bronze bar flat into a sheet of the same metal, ready for alloy armor.
Cast a heated copper, tin or bronze bar into six nails of the same metal.
